title: Core Skills Competencies
description: Hands-on skill building across all 11 C3 competencies. Covers communication, relationship-building, service navigation, coaching, advocacy, health education, assessment, outreach, professional ethics, documentation, and evaluation and research methods (CBPR/PAR).
notes: Adapted from Calbright College CHW program outline (course 03 / CHW 503), renumbered per CCC convention.
lesson_length: Lab-guide lessons, roughly 1500-2000 words each, supporting instructor-led sessions and independent study
learning_objectives: Apply plain-language communication, active listening, and teach-back with clients
Use motivational interviewing and relationship-building skills while maintaining boundaries
Apply navigation, advocacy, education, assessment, outreach, documentation, and evaluation skills in practice scenarios

lessons.title: Communication Skills in Practice
objectives: Apply plain-language communication, active listening, and teach-back with clients
Adapt communication mode to client needs with empathy on sensitive topics

lessons.title: Relationship Building and Motivational Interviewing
objectives: Use motivational interviewing and relationship-building skills while maintaining boundaries
Work with ambivalence and respond to emotional cues without pressuring

lessons.title: Service Navigation and Coaching Skills
objectives: Help clients schedule, complete referrals, and navigate systems while building their independence
Maintain a current resource directory and step back as client capacity grows

lessons.title: Advocacy and Health Education Skills
objectives: Apply navigation, advocacy, education, assessment, outreach, documentation, and evaluation skills in practice scenarios
Facilitate participatory education sessions and adjust delivery in real time

lessons.title: Assessment, Outreach, and Documentation
objectives: Conduct needs assessments, document findings confidentially, and triage immediate versus long-term needs
Run field outreach with accurate contact tracking

lessons.title: Ethics, Evaluation, and Research Methods
objectives: Apply confidentiality, boundary management, and mandated reporting in practice scenarios
Collect program data accurately and participate in evaluation, including CBPR/PAR methods

sequencing_rationale: Course 3 of 6: hands-on skills across all 11 C3 competencies — the practice core of the pathway and the course that carries most of the skills matrix. Communication first (foundation for everything), then relationship building and MI, then the applied service skills, closing with ethics, evaluation, and research methods (CBPR/PAR at awareness level). Scope assumption: every lesson is drill-and-practice against observable behaviors from the skills matrix, not theory.
